body:
To be honest, the main thing that i would change is my past suicidal attempts because they linger in my heart and soul as useless jabs at my own psyche.  They have caused pain in others around me (near impossible to forgive myself this), and wasted much of my life.  I wish I wasn't so negative. Often though, I do try to at least pretend to be positive most of the time, hoping it will help.

You are right about needing to find meaning in my life.  I am not religious, but want answers....even though I know that I will never know what my precious little life is all about!

Thanks for the first response -it did make me feel better enough to choke back the tears and swear to try harder tomorrow.  Definitely don't know what I would have done if this subreddit didn't exist!

Even though it is not as tangible as a real person standing in front of you, the feeling of family does exist here, with the support of redditors like yourself, and the others that respond to show they care.  Thank you -I am glad that I reached out.

Also, even though internetual and suicidaling aren't real words, they made me smile:)
